info.name: Mortgage Application API — Interview demonstration
info.description:
# Mortgage Application API

Run the .NET 10 API locally, then run this collection in order. No authentication or frontend is required. Default baseUrl: http://localhost:5080 (no trailing slash). Folder 01 creates fresh references; later folders use them automatically. The complete collection assumes the default 6% / 90% LTV / 45% DTI / 4.5× income policy.

Every Send/Runner action calls the real API. Post-response assertions inspect actual responses; there are no mocks or frontend validators. Expected 400 and 404 responses count as passing examples when the API returns the documented error. Assessment POSTs have no body; every explicit POST creates a new saved record, including declines. Running the collection writes two applications and three assessments per complete run. Use a local demo database; no cleanup endpoint exists.

For a short interview demo, show folder 01 requests 01–04, folder 04 request 03, then folder 03 requests 01–02. Run the full collection separately to show history and error coverage. Existing collection variables are regenerated by the first request. Do not create same-named environment variables for captured IDs; they would override collection scope.

Import the optional localhost environment or edit the collection baseUrl. See Postman/README.md and DEMONSTRATION.md in the repository.
